vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component defines a hierarchy of fixed-dimension mathematical vector classes (Vector2, Vector3, Vector4) used for spatial and directional data representation. It wraps underlying gl-matrix types (vec2, vec3, vec4) to provide a strongly typed, object-oriented TypeScript interface. Crucially, all classes implement JsonSerializable, enabling reliable state persistence and deserialization from JSON structures.
